info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_ATM Network Configuration Update API
info.description: The ATM Network Configuration Update API enables financial institutions to modify the settings and parameters associated with their ATM networks. This API allows for adjustments tailored to specific channels, ensuring optimal performance and compliance with operational standards. Typical users include banking system administrators and network managers who require efficient ways to update configurations as needed. By providing a straightforward interface for managing ATM network attributes, this API enhances the overall service delivery of banking operations.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific ATM Network Management resource identified by its unique identifier. Ensure that you provide the necessary data in the request body to make the update successfully.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the ATM network management for a specific resource identified by RES-100045. It contains the necessary fields for modifying the existing configuration to ensure that the network operates according to the latest requirements.

200.description: Request completed successfully, the resource has been updated.
